accepted.quote: It remains puzzling that this majority purports to champion civil rights enforcement while simultaneously supporting the destruction of the office charged with enforcing educational civil rights.
accepted.rationale: The signer criticizes undermining OCR and defends the office charged with enforcing educational civil rights, indicating support for civil rights enforcement in schools.
